This '''shipping company''' operated in the [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorian]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Sundari/Legends|Sundari]] on [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="Corruption" />

==History==
The company had offices near the docks on the surface of [[Sundari/Legends|Sundari's]] exterior habitat bubble.
[[Siddiq/Legends|Siddiq]] was an employee at the company, working as an importer of goods. A [[Moogan/Legends|Moogan]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] ring made a deal with him to distribute [[Ardees Beverage/Legends|their wares]] across the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. This inadvertently led to the [[Poison/Legends|poisoning]] of many [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorian]] children.<ref name="Corruption" />
